parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Cost Item ID - if you are using the Gueslists API this is the "ticket id", the unique identifier for the ticket being scanned.

parameters.name: cost_item_id
parameters.description: The Cost Item ID - if you are using the Gueslists API this is the "ticket id", the unique identifier for the ticket being scanned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The limit on the number of returned documents, max 1000

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of documents to skip in the result set (the starting point for the set returned)

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO8601 timestamp, which filters for documents updated/created after this moment in time.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Restrict the Guestlist to just one Event

parameters.name: listing_id
parameters.description: Restrict the Guestlist to just one Listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Listing ID you are adding Rates to

price.description: Amount of the rate in dollars

capacity.description: The max number of this Rate that can be sold per Event ("timeslot")

name.description: The display name of the rate - needs to be unique

min_tickets.description: The minimum quantity a buyer must purchase of this rate in a single order

max_tickets.description: The maximum quantity a buyer must purchase of this rate in a single order

discountable.description: Whether or not discounts can be used on this rate

listing_id.description: The Listing ID to which the Discount Code will apply

code.description: The user-facing string that functions as the Diiscount Code itself

quantity.description: The number of times the Discount Code can be redemeed

rate_ids.description: A list of the Rate IDs (ticket types) for which the Discount Code is redeemable

percent.description: A percent amount of the discount from 0 to 1. Either this field or discount_code[fixed] must be submitted - only one is actually required

fixed.description: A dollar-amount of the discount. Either this field or discount_code[percent] must be submitted - only one is actually required
